quest.title: Unexpected Power
quest.description: As you advanced, a Statue of The Seven appeared on the horizon ahead of you. At Paimon's suggestion, you go to investigate.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x20, Mora x1100, Sweet Madame x10, Teyvat Fried Egg x10, Character EXP x575

chapter.title: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Did you just feel the elements of the world?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems all you had to do was just touch the statue and you got the power of Anemo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As much as they may want it, people in this world can never get a hold of powers as easily as you...

choices.text: I think I know why, it's because...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah-ha, it's because you're not from this world to begin with.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we keep heading west from here, we'll eventually reach Mondstadt, the City of Freedom.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mondstadt is the city of wind, because they worship the God of Anemo.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So perhaps, because you got power from the God of Anemo, you can find some clues there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #There are also lots of bards there, so perhaps one of them has heard news of your {M#sister}{F#brother}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The elements in this world responded to your prayers and Paimon thinks that's a lovely sign.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a bit rude to say that about the power the gods just gave you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You can use a new ability! <color=#00E1FFFF>{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press} your Elemental Skill</color> to give it a go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Focus your energy to do more damage! <color=#00E1FFFF>Hold your Elemental Skill</color> to see what happens!
